The second male looks toward the first with a neutral, slightly inquisitive expression. (3) The first male begins an energetic, rhythmic dance routine involving wide arm swings and high leg kicks directly in front of the seated man. A pink heart-shaped frame overlay appears momentarily around the seated man's face. (4) The first man continues dancing with high arousal, at one point stepping on the seated man's foot. A third, larger male wearing a green graphic t-shirt and black shorts enters the frame, performing chaotic, high-energy dance movements and waving his hands wildly. The seated man remains on the sofa, looking increasingly helpless and amused.
